cases.test_case_title: Post accruals, provisions, and prepaid releases through period close
cases.preconditions: Accrual schemes can be configured per Heartstream legal entity with start/end dates, frequency, and accrual/expense main accounts aligned to the agreed COA. Prepaid balance-sheet accounts and dedicated journal names for provisions (warranty, doubtful debt) and CONQ journals exist.
cases.coverage_focus: Accrual schemes, provision and CONQ journals, prepaid release, and month-end reconciliation to trial balance

steps.detailed_test_step: Configure accrual schemes per Heartstream legal entity with start/end dates, frequency, and accrual/expense main accounts aligned to the agreed COA.
steps.test_data: Heartstream legal entity; agreed COA accrual and expense main accounts
steps.expected_result: The accrual scheme is stored with the cited dates, frequency, and main accounts for that legal entity.

steps.detailed_test_step: Post a vendor invoice or expense line with the accrual scheme attached.
steps.expected_result: D365 automatically generates the accrual entries for each period of the scheme.

steps.detailed_test_step: Post provision journals (warranty, doubtful debt) and CONQ journals using the dedicated journal names, entering financial dimensions for cost center, product, and legal entity.
steps.test_data: warranty; doubtful debt; dimensions: cost center, product, legal entity
steps.expected_result: The provision and CONQ journals post with the mandatory financial dimensions present.

steps.detailed_test_step: Set up recurring provision entries via recurring journal templates and post the monthly recurrence without re-keying the lines.
steps.expected_result: The monthly provision posts from the template without re-keying.

steps.detailed_test_step: Attach supporting calculation files to an accrual or provision journal and complete the journal approval workflow, then post.
steps.expected_result: The journal carries the calculation attachment, completes approval, and posts.

steps.detailed_test_step: Record prepaid expenses (insurance, software licences, or maintenance contracts) against a prepaid balance-sheet account with a defined release schedule.
steps.test_data: insurance, software licences, or maintenance contracts
steps.expected_result: The prepaid is recorded on the balance-sheet account with the release schedule stored.

steps.detailed_test_step: Run the period release of prepayments (accrual scheme or recurring journal) and confirm vendor prepayments on purchase orders are applied when the final vendor invoice is settled.
steps.expected_result: Release posts to the correct P&L account and dimensions; vendor prepayments are applied on settlement.

steps.detailed_test_step: View remaining prepaid balance and release schedule per document, then report accrual and provision balances by entity, account, and dimension and reconcile prepaid and accrual balances to the trial balance at month end.
steps.expected_result: Remaining prepaid balance and schedule are visible per document; accrual, provision, and prepaid balances reconcile to the GL / trial balance.

cases.test_case_title: Block accrual or provision posting without mandatory dimensions or approval
cases.preconditions: Dedicated journal names for provision and CONQ journals exist. Financial dimensions cost center, product, and legal entity are mandatory on those journals. Journal approval workflow is required before posting.
cases.coverage_focus: Accrual schemes, provision and CONQ journals, prepaid release, and month-end reconciliation to trial balance

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to post a provision journal (warranty or doubtful debt) or CONQ journal with cost center, product, or legal entity omitted.
steps.test_data: warranty or doubtful debt; omit a mandatory dimension
steps.expected_result: Posting is refused because financial dimensions (cost center, product, legal entity) are mandatory.

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to post an accrual or provision journal that has not completed the journal approval workflow.
steps.expected_result: The journal does not post until the journal approval workflow is completed.

cases.test_case_title: Allocate enabling-function costs and post allocation journals
cases.preconditions: Ledger allocation rules can be configured for enabling-function costs. Statistical data such as headcount/FTE or sales is available from GL or statistical accounts. Journal approval workflow is in place for allocation journals.
cases.coverage_focus: Ledger allocation rules (basis, fixed percentage, fixed weight, equal), batch close calendar, and net-to-zero postings

steps.detailed_test_step: Configure ledger allocation rules for enabling-function costs (IT, HR, Finance) using basis, fixed percentage, fixed weight, and equal methods.
steps.test_data: enabling-function costs: IT, HR, Finance; methods: basis, fixed percentage, fixed weight, equal
steps.expected_result: Allocation rules exist for each cited method and enabling-function cost.

steps.detailed_test_step: Configure a basis allocation that uses statistical data such as headcount/FTE or sales sourced from GL or statistical accounts.
steps.expected_result: The basis allocation uses the cited statistical data from GL or statistical accounts.

steps.detailed_test_step: Generate allocation journals via the allocation process, review them, and post through the journal approval workflow.
steps.expected_result: Allocation journals are generated, reviewed, approved, and posted.

steps.detailed_test_step: Schedule allocation runs as batch jobs on the month-end close calendar for all Heartstream legal entities.
steps.test_data: Heartstream legal entities; month-end close calendar
steps.expected_result: Allocation runs are scheduled as batch jobs for the cited legal entities and close calendar.

steps.detailed_test_step: Inspect posted allocations for source and destination accounts/dimensions and confirm results in management reporting (PR-006).
steps.expected_result: Posted allocations show source and destination accounts/dimensions, net to zero at the source, and are visible in management reporting (PR-006).

cases.test_case_title: Block allocation journal posting until approval workflow completes
cases.preconditions: An allocation journal has been generated via the allocation process. Journal approval workflow is required before posting.
cases.coverage_focus: Ledger allocation rules (basis, fixed percentage, fixed weight, equal), batch close calendar, and net-to-zero postings

steps.detailed_test_step: Generate an allocation journal via the allocation process and attempt to post it without completing the journal approval workflow.
steps.expected_result: The allocation journal is not posted until it has been reviewed and posted through the journal approval workflow.

cases.test_case_title: Configure posting policies, journal approval, and scheduled batch posting
cases.preconditions: Journal names can be defined by purpose with separate number sequences. Account structures and dimension rules are available. Heartstream close calendar and legal-entity time zones are known.
cases.coverage_focus: Journal names and posting controls, amount-based approval workflow, and scheduled batch posting including DMF

steps.detailed_test_step: Define journal names by purpose (manual GL, accruals, allocations, reclass, intercompany, integrations) with separate number sequences.
steps.test_data: manual GL, accruals, allocations, reclass, intercompany, integrations
steps.expected_result: Each purpose has a journal name and a separate number sequence.

steps.detailed_test_step: Create a manual journal and complete mandatory fields (financial dimensions, description, and attachment where required).
steps.expected_result: Mandatory fields are enforced on the manual journal.

steps.detailed_test_step: Configure journal approval workflows for manual GL journals with amount-based approval thresholds, then submit a journal for approval.
steps.expected_result: The workflow applies the amount-based threshold and routes the journal to an approver.

steps.detailed_test_step: As an approver, receive the notification and approve with comments (or delegate); confirm workflow history records who, when, action, and comments.
steps.expected_result: Approvers can approve, reject, or delegate with comments; workflow history is retained and reportable for audit.

steps.detailed_test_step: Set up batch groups and recurring batch jobs for journal posting, invoice posting, integrations (DMF), and period-end processes, scheduled by legal entity and time zone to fit the Heartstream close calendar.
steps.test_data: Heartstream close calendar; legal entity and time zone
steps.expected_result: Batch jobs exist for the cited processes and are scheduled by legal entity and time zone.

steps.detailed_test_step: Run a scheduled batch job and open batch job history for that run.
steps.expected_result: History shows start/end time, status, and records processed for the run. Posting policies remain documented and aligned to Heartstream's SOX control matrix.

cases.test_case_title: Enforce segregation of duties, rejection, posting restrictions, and invalid combinations
cases.preconditions: Journal approval workflow is configured for manual GL journals. Posting restrictions by user/group apply to integration journals (payroll, subscription billing). Account structures and dimension rules are active. Batch job schedule changes are limited to system administrators/authorised roles.
cases.coverage_focus: Journal names and posting controls, amount-based approval workflow, and scheduled batch posting including DMF

steps.detailed_test_step: Submit a manual GL journal and, as the same submitter, attempt to approve that journal.
steps.expected_result: The submitter cannot approve their own journal (segregation of duties).

steps.detailed_test_step: As an approver, reject the journal with a reason, then attempt to post the rejected journal without resubmission.
steps.expected_result: The rejected journal returns to the submitter with reasons and cannot be posted until resubmitted.

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to post an integration journal (payroll or subscription billing) as a user who is neither the integration nor an authorised user.
steps.test_data: payroll or subscription billing integration journal
steps.expected_result: Posting is refused; integration journals can only be posted by the integration or authorised users.

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to post a journal that uses an invalid account structure or dimension combination.
steps.expected_result: Account structures and dimension rules prevent posting the invalid combination.

steps.detailed_test_step: As a role that is not a system administrator or authorised role, attempt to create or modify a batch job schedule. Separately, inspect a failed batch job.
steps.expected_result: Only system administrators/authorised roles can create or modify batch job schedules. Failed batch jobs generate alerts to the responsible team with error details.

cases.test_case_title: Analyze costs and management P&L after allocations
cases.preconditions: Financial dimensions for product, sales team, distributor/customer, and cost center are available on relevant transactions. Statistical FTE/headcount data is available. Period close has completed so reports can refresh.
cases.coverage_focus: Dimensional cost analysis, management P&L after allocations, and reconciliation to trial balance

steps.detailed_test_step: Confirm financial dimensions for product, sales team, distributor/customer, and cost center are available on relevant transactions, and that statistical FTE/headcount data is available for cost-per-FTE analysis.
steps.test_data: product; sales team; distributor/customer; cost center; FTE/headcount
steps.expected_result: The cited dimensions and FTE/headcount statistical data are available on relevant transactions.

steps.detailed_test_step: Analyze costs by a combination of those dimensions in Financial reporting and Power BI, then drill from summary to voucher level.
steps.expected_result: Costs can be analyzed by any combination of the cited dimensions; reports drill down from summary to voucher level.

steps.detailed_test_step: Open management P&L reports showing revenue, cost, and margin after allocations by product, market, channel (direct/indirect/D2C), and legal entity, including actual vs prior period.
steps.expected_result: Management P&L shows revenue, cost, and margin after allocations by the cited slices; actual vs prior period comparison is available.

steps.detailed_test_step: After period close, refresh the reports and confirm they show the period status used and include agreed KPIs (gross margin %, subscription vs device revenue).
steps.test_data: gross margin %; subscription vs device revenue
steps.expected_result: Reports refresh after period close, show the period status used, and include the cited KPIs agreed with Heartstream Finance.

steps.detailed_test_step: Reconcile cost analysis reports to the trial balance for the period.
steps.expected_result: Cost analysis reports reconcile to the trial balance for the period.

cases.test_case_title: Restrict management reports to role-based access
cases.preconditions: Management P&L and cost analysis reports are published in Financial reporting and Power BI with role-based access.
cases.coverage_focus: Dimensional cost analysis, management P&L after allocations, and reconciliation to trial balance

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to open management P&L or cost analysis reports in Financial reporting and Power BI using a user who is not granted the role-based access.
steps.expected_result: The reports are not available to that user; access is limited by role-based access.

cases.test_case_title: Import Deel payroll journals, map to GL, and reconcile clearing
cases.preconditions: Payroll pay-code mapping to main accounts and employee cost center/department mapping to D365 financial dimensions is maintained in a controlled table by Finance. Approved payroll results for a pay run are available from Deel. Feature Fit Gap Status on Payroll Integration-Deel-Finance is Gap; story Fit Gap Status is TBD pending provider confirmation.
cases.coverage_focus: Deel payroll import to general journals, pay-code mapping, and payroll clearing reconciliation

steps.detailed_test_step: In the controlled mapping table maintained by Finance, map payroll pay codes (gross pay, net pay, taxes, deductions, employer costs) to main accounts and map employee cost center/department to D365 financial dimensions.
steps.test_data: gross pay, net pay, taxes, deductions, employer costs
steps.expected_result: Pay codes map to main accounts and employee cost center/department maps to D365 financial dimensions. Mapping changes are logged.

steps.detailed_test_step: Import approved payroll results for the pay run into D365 as general journals per legal entity.
steps.test_data: Deel approved payroll results; per legal entity
steps.expected_result: Salary, benefits, payroll provisions, and employer taxes post to the correct accounts as general journals per legal entity.

steps.detailed_test_step: Reconcile imported journal totals to the payroll provider register.
steps.expected_result: Imported totals reconcile to the payroll provider register.

steps.detailed_test_step: After the salary payment is reconciled with the bank, confirm net pay clearing clears; after payroll tax and deductions are paid to authorities/providers, confirm those liabilities clear.
steps.expected_result: Net pay clearing clears on bank reconciliation of the salary payment; tax and deduction liabilities clear when paid.

steps.detailed_test_step: Run the month-end payroll clearing reconciliation: report open balances on payroll clearing accounts per pay run and investigate and correct differences.
steps.expected_result: Open balances are reportable per pay run; reconciliation is part of month-end close; differences are investigated and corrected.

cases.test_case_title: Stop unmapped payroll codes and prevent duplicate pay-run posting
cases.preconditions: Payroll mapping table is in use. An approved pay run can be imported. At least one pay code can be left unmapped for the negative path.
cases.coverage_focus: Deel payroll import to general journals, pay-code mapping, and payroll clearing reconciliation

steps.detailed_test_step: Import approved payroll results that include a pay code not present in the mapping table.
steps.expected_result: The import stops with a clear error for the unmapped code.

steps.detailed_test_step: After a successful import of a pay run, import the same pay run again.
steps.expected_result: The second import does not duplicate posting of that pay run (idempotent).

steps.detailed_test_step: Trigger an import that fails for a logged error, then reprocess after correcting the error.
steps.expected_result: Import errors are logged with alerts and can be reprocessed.
